title: Chamberlain Escalardian
summary: Defeat the island’s castellans and constables to summon Chamberlain Escalardian.
overview: Defeat the island’s castellans and constables to summon Chamberlain Escalardian.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: The fifth, tenth and fifteenth qualifying castellan kills summon a constable. Defeat all three constables to reach the final opponent.
Escalardian periodically clears his hate list. Tanks should be ready to reclaim him while damage dealers avoid an uncontrolled burst.
If the main encounter is already on cooldown, an apprentice appears instead.
The island event has a three-hour failure timer.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
